title: A wizard walks into Ravenwood's POI in the Commons, which fires its trigger, after arriving inside a volume fired nothing
notes: 6.13: the wizard enters the Commons standing inside its home volume, which fires no enter, even as it walks about inside it. As a game master
it is put just outside Ravenwood's POI sphere four times, facing each quarter turn, and walks forward each time; whichever way leads in,
the server logs the volume's Enter_Ravenwood POI event and the trigger it fires, Trigger POI Ravenwood.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: make the main account a game master
the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
log in
the server accepts the password
the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
the game server puts the wizard in the Commons
steps.pattern: put wizard {wizard_guid} in WizardCity/WC_Hub instance \d+ at .* with mobile id (\d+),

steps.name: the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard arrives inside the Commons' home volume without firing its enter
steps.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} arrived in WizardCity/WC_Hub inside (\d+) of its \d+ volume\(s\), firing no enter

steps.name: the wizard walks about inside the home volume
walking inside the volume it arrived in fires no enter
open the chat line to type .go xyz facing no turn
take out the slash the key writes before .go xyz facing no turn
type .go xyz facing no turn
send .go xyz facing no turn
the wizard stands just outside Ravenwood's POI facing no turn
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {wizard_guid} was teleported within WizardCity/WC_Hub to \((\S+, \S+, \S+)\) facing

steps.name: the camera settles facing no turn
the wizard walks forward facing no turn
open the chat line to type .go xyz facing a quarter turn
take out the slash the key writes before .go xyz facing a quarter turn
type .go xyz facing a quarter turn
send .go xyz facing a quarter turn
the wizard stands just outside Ravenwood's POI facing a quarter turn
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {wizard_guid} was teleported within WizardCity/WC_Hub to \((\S+, \S+, \S+)\) facing

steps.name: the camera settles facing a quarter turn
the wizard walks forward facing a quarter turn
open the chat line to type .go xyz facing a half turn
take out the slash the key writes before .go xyz facing a half turn
type .go xyz facing a half turn
send .go xyz facing a half turn
the wizard stands just outside Ravenwood's POI facing a half turn
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {wizard_guid} was teleported within WizardCity/WC_Hub to \((\S+, \S+, \S+)\) facing

steps.name: the camera settles facing a half turn
the wizard walks forward facing a half turn
open the chat line to type .go xyz facing three quarter turns
take out the slash the key writes before .go xyz facing three quarter turns
type .go xyz facing three quarter turns
send .go xyz facing three quarter turns
the wizard stands just outside Ravenwood's POI facing three quarter turns
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {wizard_guid} was teleported within WizardCity/WC_Hub to \((\S+, \S+, \S+)\) facing

steps.name: the camera settles facing three quarter turns
the wizard walks forward facing three quarter turns
walking into Ravenwood's POI posts its enter event, which fires its trigger
steps.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} entered volume 0 \(Ravenwood POI\) in WizardCity/WC_Hub, posting Enter_Ravenwood POI, which fired (.+)$
